chapter: Bands: Steps Ahead, L'Image, Steely Dan and Simon
title: Joining Steps Ahead
summary: The co-op band's history with Mike Mainieri and his long association with him.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: Let me zoom through — it’s a little hard to pick things — but when you got that Steps Ahead group going.

First it was Steps, and Don Grolnick was the original pianist. Steve Gadd, Eddie Gomez, Michael Brecker. And then Eliane Elias joined and Peter Erskine joined, because Steve was busy with something else. And then When Eliane left I was asked to join the band. That was another co-op band. This is my second co-op band. But it takes a unanimous decision to take the tiniest step. It’s really painful. Nobody can say what we’re doing next. That was more Mike’s baby, you know, like he’d kind of guide the way. That’s a © Fillius Jazz Archive -15-
long association in my life, in my career too, because I’ve been playing with him for 46 years now. He’s an amazing player.
